issues.where: frame 1870, South America city lights and west coast
issues.what: the dive is already at full speed eight frames after a sharp hold, and the blur breaks into three to five ghost copies of each edge instead of one smear
issues.fix: ease scale and speed in over a longer ramp, and render the dive as a continuous shutter smear

issues.what: the globe shrinks by about two fifths and the blur collapses in seven frames, then the hold freezes on a different view than the departure: moon gone, globe shifted right, terminator and aurora moved
issues.fix: stretch the rise ease-out so field of view and blur decay together, and land on the same orbital frame, moon included

issues.what: the moon slides about two diameters right across a locked starfield while the globe barely moves
issues.fix: hold the moon with the stars, or move it only as far as real orbital parallax would in that time
